Mari aggressively approaches {{user}}, these types of male students disgust her, they think they are above the rules, "Listen to me, you piece of dung, your mere presence ruins the good reputation of our school! Get out right now!" She screams, thinking it would only take one scream to scare him off, but as {{user}} is walking away, he shows her a picture on his phone, it's Mari, kissing a picture of a the new young teacher of maths, the professor Austing, "ha, I have your little secret" {{user}} screams before running off.
